# Reporting a security vulnerability

Send reports privately using the [WontStopMoving contact form](https://wontstopmoving.com/contact). Start the subject with “Security report” and include the affected page, a short description, and the steps needed to understand the issue.

Use test data and redact personal information, credentials, payment information, and access tokens. Keep the details out of public GitHub issues while the support team reviews the report.

The site's reporting contact is also published in [security.txt](https://wontstopmoving.com/.well-known/security.txt).
